endorsements.quote: Comparative trials assessing CDSS-augmented interventions against standard care can also help identify best practices and clarify where AI support is most beneficial.

This reality thus underscores the need to strike the right balance between human judgment and AI support, establish careful oversight, and clearly define responsibilities to safeguard patient trust, reduce disparities, and prevent harm [ 21 ].

unlisted_practices: Design CDSSs with flexibility to accommodate multiple guideline sources and remain transparent about their recommendation logic.
Ensure CDSSs guarantee data privacy, transparency, and explainability so clinicians and patients, especially minors, can understand and trust outputs.
Apply human-computer interaction principles and co-design with clinicians and patients to ensure CDSS usability and engagement.
Establish transparent boundaries between AI-assisted decision-making and autonomous clinical judgment to prevent diffusion of responsibility.

screen.reason: This is a concept paper providing a theoretical discussion and recommendations/framework regarding AI-augmented CDSS deployment and ethical considerations for ADHD care.
